# The Atlanta List

> A curated directory of top-rated Atlanta home service pros. Plumbers, electricians, HVAC techs, roofers, and house cleaners. Rankings based on ratings, never sold.

## What this is

The Atlanta List is a homeowner-facing directory of curated home service businesses in Atlanta, GA. Pros pay a flat membership to list; homeowners browse free. Rankings are by rating and review count, not by who paid the most.

## Directory structure

- `app/page.tsx` - Homepage with hero, trade grid, featured pros, neighborhoods, how-it-works
- `app/[slug]/page.tsx` - Trade listing pages (e.g. /plumbers, /electricians, /hvac, /roofers, /cleaners)
- `app/pro/[slug]/page.tsx` - Individual business profile pages with LocalBusiness JSON-LD
- `app/quiz/page.tsx` - "Find your pro" 3-step concierge flow (trade, neighborhood, timing)
- `app/areas/page.tsx` - Neighborhood index
- `app/areas/[slug]/page.tsx` - Neighborhood-specific listing pages
- `app/for-pros/page.tsx` - Pro-facing page with membership tiers and claim flow
- `app/admin/page.tsx` - Admin panel (password-gated via edge function)
- `components/pro-card.tsx` - Business card component used across listing pages
- `components/quote-form.tsx` - Quote request form on profile pages
- `components/schema.tsx` - JSON-LD serializer and renderer
- `components/breadcrumbs.tsx` - Breadcrumb navigation with BreadcrumbList JSON-LD
- `lib/supabase.ts` - Supabase client, Pro interface, getApprovedPros, getProBySlug
- `lib/trades.ts` - Trade definitions (slug, name, intro, FAQ, skills)
- `lib/neighborhoods.ts` - Atlanta neighborhood definitions (slug, name, intro)
- `supabase/functions/admin-pros/index.ts` - Admin edge function (list/update pros)
- `supabase/functions/checkout/index.ts` - Checkout edge function for memberships

## Trades

| Slug       | Name           | What they do                                      |
|------------|----------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| plumbers   | Plumbers       | Repairs, drains, water heaters, emergency leaks   |
| electricians | Electricians | Panels, wiring, EV chargers, lighting, generators  |
| hvac       | HVAC           | AC repair, furnace, tune-ups, system replacement   |
| roofers    | Roofers        | Leak repair, full replacement, storm damage        |
| cleaners   | House Cleaners | Recurring, deep clean, move-out, green products   |

## Neighborhoods

Buckhead, Midtown, Decatur, Virginia-Highland, East Atlanta, Westside, Sandy Springs, Brookhaven.

## Listing data structure

Each business (pro) has:
- `slug` - URL-safe identifier, used in `/pro/[slug]` URLs
- `name` - Business name
- `trade_slug` / `trade_name` - Which trade category they belong to
- `phone` - Contact phone
- `website` - External website URL (validated server-side)
- `address`, `city`, `state`, `zip` - Physical location
- `neighborhoods` - Array of Atlanta neighborhood names they serve
- `services` - Array of specialty tags
- `hours` - Business hours string
- `rating` - Numeric rating (e.g. 4.9)
- `review_count` - Integer review count
- `review_url` - External reviews page URL (validated server-side)
- `tier` - Membership tier: "free", "featured", or "premium"
- `approved` - Boolean, must be true to appear publicly

## URLs

- Homepage: `/`
- Trade pages: `/{trade-slug}` (e.g. `/plumbers`)
- Business profile: `/pro/{pro-slug}`
- Neighborhood pages: `/areas/{neighborhood-slug}`
- Find your pro: `/quiz`
- For pros: `/for-pros`
- Admin: `/admin` (not indexed)

## Technical notes

- Next.js 13.5.1 App Router with static generation
- Supabase for data with row-level security
- Business profile pages include LocalBusiness JSON-LD with name, address, phone, aggregateRating, and areaServed
- Trade pages include FAQPage JSON-LD
- All pages use semantic HTML (h1, h2, h3, ul, li) with no critical content behind client-only rendering
- Business profile pages are server-rendered with stable, human-readable URLs
